Compute shouldn’t be the bottleneck for your next big idea.

We're launching Modal for Builders, a program that provides compute credits to builders working on ambitious AI projects.

Have a demo you’ve been wanting to build? A research question you want to explore?  Or another idea that needs compute? 

We’d like to hear about it. Apply with your idea and an estimate of the compute you’ll need. Projects may also be featured on Modal’s social channels.

One thing that's surprising about this game: EVERYTHING IS CODE. 

All textures and models are functions. There are no images or 3D models. Claude didn't draw, it wrote shaders. Everything is Math. That sounds wild - the source is in the HTML, so you can inspect it yourself. https://t.co/vFlFFRlJhF https://t.co/pCNyRCyPfh
